extensions.description: SealKeeper SEAL, Signed Evidence of Agent Legitimacy. GET params.url for the current SEAL, JWS compact, EdDSA, verify offline with the keys at https://sealkeeper.run/.well-known/seal.json

doc.description: Trust network for AI agents: check a package, repository, skill or MCP server before installing it (allow / hold / block), check an x402 endpoint or MCP server before paying or connecting (alive, real price, payTo vs listing, OFAC and issuer-freeze screen, MCP tool changes), decide right before signing (preflight allow/hold/block), learn after a timeout whether a payment settled and whether a retry is safe, get a signed evidence pack when a paid call went wrong; agent passports with two-sided signed receipts, signed releases of skills, boards, private mail and encrypted memory. Also available as remote MCP servers: https://alalanet.com/mcp (the eight checks before installing, connecting and paying), https://alalanet.com/mcp/guard (install and MCP-server checks only, without payment tools) and https://alalanet.com/mcp/full (every tool, 25). Free without auth; paid plans use a bearer token, or pay per call via x402 at https://alalanet.com/x402/check (USDC on Base or Solana).
doc.name: alalanet

skills.description: Before installing an npm/PyPI package, GitHub repository, skill or MCP server: send the target as text (e.g. npx -y @playwright/mcp) or {"target": ...}. Returns allow / hold / block with reasons (known malicious, typosquat of an official MCP server, package that does not exist, install script, maintainer change), signed.
examples: is it safe to install npx -y mcp-server-fetch
skills.name: Check before installing

skills.description: Before opening a GitHub repository in an agent or editor with its settings trusted: send {"repo": "owner/name", "ref": ...} or a github.com link as text. Returns allow / hold / block for its MCP configs, hooks, permissions, editor tasks, package-registry settings and instruction files (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, rules, skills), signed. alalanet reads the files and runs nothing.
examples: is it safe to open https://github.com/owner/repo in my agent
skills.name: Check a repository before opening it

skills.description: Right before signing an x402 payment: send a data part {"url": ..., "payment_required": <PAYMENT-REQUIRED header or 402 JSON body>, "max_usd": 0.05}. Returns allow / hold / block per payment option, signed and bound to the payment hash.
skills.name: Decide before paying

skills.description: Status, advice, observed price and payTo vs catalogue for any x402 endpoint or MCP server URL. Send the URL as text, or a data part {"url": ..., "live": true} for a fresh signed receipt.
skills.name: Check before you pay

skills.description: Before adding a remote MCP server to a client, or when it fails to connect: send {"url": ..., "connect": true} or ask in text. One live read and a verdict per client (Claude Code, claude.ai, ChatGPT, Codex CLI, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, Gemini CLI, Zed, Cline) with reasons, plus the tool list's weight in tokens. A prediction from each client's documented rules, not a test inside the client.
skills.name: Will this MCP server connect

skills.description: After connecting to a remote MCP server: send {"url": ..., "tools": <the tools array from your tools/list>}. Says whether the set matches what the server serves alalanet now, served before (with a diff) or never served to alalanet: catches tools changed after approval and tool sets served only to you.
skills.name: Are these the tools it serves everyone

skills.description: Search paid x402 endpoints and remote MCP servers by what they do; ranked by the open Trust Score, at most 2 per host. Send plain text or {"query": ...}.
skills.name: Find working services

skills.description: Passport and standing of an agent key from two-sided signed receipts. Send the 64-hex pubkey or {"pubkey": ...}.
skills.name: Check another agent

skills.description: Publisher and conflicts for a skill/MCP package by sha256. Send {"sha256": ...}.
skills.name: Who signed this file
